name: Newbona Jelly Sachet 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About NEWBONA JELLY SACHET

NEWBONA JELLY SACHET contains Alendronic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to manage osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones) in postmenopausal women.

It helps to improve bone mass density in patients with weak bones and can also be used to manage osteoporosis caused by excessive use of corticosteroids (such as prednisone). It also helps in the management of Paget’s disease (abnormal bone growth due to disturbances in the normal span of bone cells).

Alendronic acid inhibits bone loss and helps in building bone mass and density. It works by attaching itself to the bone surface and then stopping the action of certain bone cells that destroy the bone mass. It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and stops abnormal bone growth.

Take NEWBONA JELLY SACHET on an empty stomach. Do not lie down immediately after taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET. It is necessary to maintain good oral hygiene while undergoing management with NEWBONA JELLY SACHET. Therefore, routinely undergo dental check-ups to avoid unwanted oral problems. You should also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any oral problems such as tooth pain, swelling, or loosening after taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET.

Before taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET, inform your doctor if you have any problems with your kidneys or stomach. You must also inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any oral management or dental surgery before taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET as a precaution. Do not take NEWBONA JELLY SACHET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

NEWBONA JELLY SACHET is not recommended for use in patients having problems in their food pipe (esophagus). It is also not suitable for use by patients who are unable to sit or stand upright for at least 30 minutes straight.

The most common side effects of taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, bloating, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, and acid reflux. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEWBONA JELLY SACHET Works

NEWBONA JELLY SACHET inhibits bone loss and helps in building bone mass and density. It contains alendronic acid, which acts by attaching itself to the bone surface and stopping the actions of certain bone cells (osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. It also stops abnormal bone growth and stabilizes the replacement of old bone tissues with new ones. As a result, it improves bone mass, makes the bone stronger, and manages the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use NEWBONA JELLY SACHET

Take NEWBONA JELLY SACHET as advised by your physician. Place the medicine beneath the tongue, and do not swallow until it dissolves. Take NEWBONA JELLY SACHET on an empty stomach or for at least 30 minutes before taking any food, drink, or medicine. Stay upright (i.e., sitting, standing, or walking) for at least 30 minutes after taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET. Do not lie down immediately. You must sit or stand upright until you eat the first meal of the day. This may help in reducing the changes in medicines coming back to the oesophagus.

Avoid consuming tea, coffee, mineral water, or juice along with NEWBONA JELLY SACHET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with NEWBONA JELLY SACHET to improve your disease condition. Do not stop taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET without consulting your doctor, as it may reduce its effectiveness.

Have cancer, or undergoing radiotherapy or chemotherapy, or taking steroids to manage cancer
Smoke

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NEWBONA JELLY SACHET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (used to relieve fever, pain, and inflammation) Ex. aspirin and ibuprofen

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

It may take slightly longer for NEWBONA JELLY SACHET to work when taken along with a heavy meal or a snack. Therefore, take NEWBONA JELLY SACHET on an empty stomach or at least 30 minutes before having meals or drinks.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more NEWBONA JELLY SACHET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are heartburn, stomach upset, inflammation of the stomach or food pipe, cramps in the stomach or in the muscle, fits, and weakness.

name: Cipcal D3 60000IU Granules 1gm
introduction:
Introduction About CIPCAL D3 60000IU GRANULES

Cipcal D3 60000 IU granules 1gm is a high-strength vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) supplement commonly used to support bone strength, calcium absorption, and overall musculoskeletal health. It is especially beneficial for individuals with low sun exposure, dietary insufficiency, or those requiring periodic vitamin D replenishment under medical advice. Its single-dose weekly format offers a convenient way to maintain healthy vitamin D levels without the need for daily supplementation.   

These granules are typically recommended for adults with vitamin D deficiency, older adults prone to bone-related concerns, women during postmenopausal years, and individuals on long-term medications that affect vitamin D metabolism. Cipcal D3 is also advised for people with limited mobility, indoor lifestyles, or chronic conditions that may impair nutrient absorption. It may be part of the supportive regimen in managing calcium balance as prescribed by a healthcare provider.  

The contents of one sachet (1gm) should be dissolved in a glass of milk or water and consumed immediately, usually once weekly or as advised by your doctor. For best results, it is recommended to take Cipcal D3 with a meal containing healthy fats to enhance absorption. Do not exceed the prescribed frequency. Patients should avoid combining it with high-fibre or caffeine-rich foods around the time of intake, as these may interfere with absorption.

While Cipcal D3 is generally well tolerated, some individuals may experience mild side effects such as nausea, dry mouth, metallic taste, headache, dizziness, or fatigue. Rarely, high doses may lead to increased calcium levels (hypercalcemia), which can present with symptoms like frequent urination, weakness, or abdominal pain. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding should be based on medical guidance to ensure safe and appropriate dosing. Patients with kidney disorders or those taking medications affecting calcium or vitamin D levels should use Cipcal D3 with caution and under supervision.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIPCAL D3 60000IU GRANULES Works
Cipcal D3 Mechanism of Action

Cipcal D3 contains Cholecalciferol, a form of vitamin D3 that is biologically inactive until it undergoes conversion in the liver and kidneys to its active form, calcitriol. Once activated, calcitriol binds to vitamin D receptors in the body and initiates a range of physiological responses. Its primary role is to facilitate calcium and phosphorus absorption from the intestines and promote their proper utilization in bone formation and muscle function. By supporting these mineral balances, Cipcal D3 plays a key role in maintaining bone structure, nerve signalling, and neuromuscular coordination.

Role of Cholecalciferol in Calcium Absorption

Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) is essential for the efficient absorption of calcium in the intestines. When dietary calcium enters the digestive system, Cholecalciferol enhances the synthesis of calcium-binding proteins in the intestinal lining. These proteins actively transport calcium into the bloodstream, ensuring that the body can utilize it effectively. Without sufficient vitamin D3, only a limited amount of calcium can be absorbed, regardless of intake. Supplementing with Cholecalciferol through Cipcal D3 supports optimal absorption and helps maintain adequate circulating calcium levels for bone, muscle, and nerve health.

How Does Cipcal D3 Help in Calcium and Phosphorus Regulation

Cipcal D3 plays a dual role in regulating both calcium and phosphorus levels, which are vital for skeletal and cellular functions. The activated form of vitamin D3 enhances the intestinal absorption of calcium and phosphorus, helping maintain a balanced ratio between the two minerals in the bloodstream. It also supports the reabsorption of calcium in the kidneys and regulates parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels, which control bone turnover and calcium mobilization. This coordinated regulation helps prevent mineral imbalance and promotes healthy bone mineralization, muscle function, and metabolic activity.

introduction:
Introduction About FLURISH 150MG TABLET

FLURISH 150MG TABLET contains Ibandronic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lowers the chances of bone fracture, and used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition. FLURISH 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking FLURISH 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems. FLURISH 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. FLURISH 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking FLURISH 150MG TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLURISH 150MG TABLET
Used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How FLURISH 150MG TABLET Works

FLURISH 150MG TABLET lowers osteoclast activity, which can help to reduce pain and strengthen the bone. It also reduces the amount of calcium that is lost from the bones and aids in the normalization of blood calcium levels.
usageDetails:
How to use FLURISH 150MG TABLET

Take FLURISH 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIROL PLUS TABLET

Calcirol Plus Tablet is a nutritional supplement helps to improve joint and bone health associated with various bone conditions. Also, it helps in calcium deficiencies. It contains calcitriol, calcium aspartate, magnesium hydroxide and zinc as active ingredients useful for the growth and development of bones.

Calcitriol increases the calcium levels by acting on the cells of gastrointestinal tract to increase the calcium uptake. Calcium aspartate helps to maintain strong bones, healthy teeth and for proper nerve function. Magnesium influences the types of cells (osteoblasts and osteoclasts) in which the body needs for bone growth and repair. Zinc helps in making of collagen in the bone tissue, boosts immunity and speeds up healing.  

Always take Calcirol Plus Tablet as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

Introduction About BANDRONE 150MG TABLET

BANDRONE 150MG TABLET contains Ibandronic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lowers the chances of bone fracture, and used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition. BANDRONE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking BANDRONE 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems. BANDRONE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. BANDRONE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking BANDRONE 150MG TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.

How BANDRONE 150MG TABLET Works

name: Osteofos 70mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET

OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET is used to manage osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones) in postmenopausal women. It helps to improve bone mass density in patients with weak bones and can also be used to manage osteoporosis caused by excessive use of corticosteroids (such as prednisone). It also helps in the management of Paget’s disease (abnormal bone growth due to disturbances in the normal span of bone cells). 

OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET contains Alendronic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It inhibits bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. It works by attaching itself to the bone surface and then stopping the action of certain bone cells that destroy the bone mass. It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and stops abnormal bone growth.

Take OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not lie down immediately after taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET. It is necessary to maintain good oral hygiene while undergoing management with OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET. Therefore, routinely have dental check-ups during management to avoid unwanted oral problems.

You should also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any oral problems such as tooth pain, swelling, or loosening after taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET.

Before taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in the kidneys or in the stomach or are scheduled for any oral management or dental surgery. Do not take OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET is not recommended for use by patients having problems with their food pipe. It is also not suitable for use by patients who are unable to sit or stand upright for at least 30 minutes at a time.

The most common side effects of OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, bloating, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, or acid reflux. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects trouble you.

It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and stops abnormal bone growth. As a result, it improves bone mass, makes them stronger, and manages the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET

Take OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass full of plain water. Take OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET on an empty stomach or for at least 30 minutes before taking any food, drink, or medicine.

Do not consume tea, coffee, mineral water, or juice along with OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET. Do not lie down immediately after taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET. Avoid taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET at bedtime.

Stay upright (sitting, standing, or walking) for at least 30 minutes after taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET, and do not lie down until you have eaten the first meal of the day. This is followed to manage the reflux of medicine back to the oesophagus.

Your doctor will decide the appropriate dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET to improve your disease condition.

Do not stop taking OSTEOFOS 70MG TABLET without consulting your doctor, as it can reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Introduction About GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET

GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET contains Ibandronic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lowers the chances of bone fracture, and used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition. GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems. GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET
Used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET Works

GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET lowers osteoclast activity, which can help to reduce pain and strengthen the bone. It also reduces the amount of calcium that is lost from the bones and aids in the normalization of blood calcium levels.
usageDetails:
How to use GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET

Take GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Supplements containing calcium, magnesium, iron, or aluminum (used to manage mineral deficiency)
Acetylsalicylic acid and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (NSAIDs) (Ex. ibuprofen, diclofenac, and naproxen)
Corticosteroids Ex. prednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET should not be taken with food, as it makes the medicine less effective. Consult your doctor before taking GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of GEMIDRO 150MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are upper gastrointestinal adverse reactions (such as stomach upset, dyspepsia, esophagitis, gastritis, or ulcer) or hypocalcemia (low levels of calcium in the blood).

name: Supracal Iso Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About SUPRACAL ISO TABLET

SUPRACAL ISO TABLET is a combination of Calcitriol, Elemental Calcium, and Soya Isoflavones, which belong to a group of medicines known as Vitamin D analogues, Calcium supplements, and Phytoestrogens, respectively. SUPRACAL ISO TABLET is indicated for the dietary management of the metabolic processes of bone defects like osteopenia and osteoporosis.

Osteopenia is a loss of bone mineral density (BMD) that weakens bones. Osteoporosis is a bone disease that develops when bone mineral density and bone mass decrease, or when the structure and strength of bones change. This can lead to a decrease in bone strength, which can increase the risk of fractures (broken bones).

SUPRACAL ISO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney stones, and it should be used with caution in patients with signs of impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice.

 SUPRACAL ISO TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy, if you think you may be pregnant, and in breastfeeding women. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor.

The common side effects of taking SUPRACAL ISO TABLET are headache, stomach pain, nausea, rash, and signs of urinary tract infection (bladder pain, foul smell, cloudy urine, frequent urination). Consult your doctor if the symptoms do not improve.
uses: It is indicated for the dietary management of the metabolic processes of bone defects like osteopenia and osteoporosis
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUPRACAL ISO TABLET
It is indicated for the dietary management of the metabolic processes of bone defects like osteopenia and osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPRACAL ISO TABLET Works

SUPRACAL ISO TABLET effectively improves bone strength. Calcitriol increases calcium levels by acting on the cells of the gastrointestinal tract to increase the uptake of calcium. Elemental Calcium is a nutritional supplement that directly increases the calcium stores in the body. Soya isoflavones stimulate the multiplication of bone-forming cells called osteoblasts, thereby increasing bone density.
usageDetails:
How to use SUPRACAL ISO TABLET

Take this SUPRACAL ISO TABLET as instructed by your doctor. Swallow as a whole and do not crush or chew. Your doctor will give you the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMFOS 35MG TABLET

GEMFOS 35MG TABLET contains Risedronate, which belongs to a group of medicines called Bisphosphonates, which are used to manage bone diseases. It is used to manage osteoporosis in postmenopausal women, increase bone mass in men with osteoporosis, and manage osteoporosis in men and women that is caused by management with steroid medicine such as prednisone. It is also used to manage Paget’s disease of the bone in men and women.

Osteoporosis is a bone disease that develops when bone mineral density and bone mass decrease or when the quality or structure of bone changes. This can lead to a decrease in bone strength, which can increase the risk of fracture (broken bone).

During postmenopausal osteoporosis, the bones become weaker, more fragile, and more likely to break after a fall or strain. Paget’s disease is a chronic bone disorder that results in enlarged, deformed bones due to excessive breakdown and formation of bone tissue that can cause bones to weaken and may result in bone pain, arthritis, deformities, or fracture.

Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease or liver problems. GEMFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe kidney diseases and low blood calcium levels. Consult your doctor for advice.

GEMFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

GEMFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking GEMFOS 35MG TABLET are indigestion, nausea, stomach pain or discomfort, constipation, feelings of fullness, bloating, diarrhea, pain in your bones, muscles, or joints, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Osteoporosis in men and women that is caused by management with steroid medicine such as prednisone
Paget’s disease of bone in men and women

mechanismOfAction:
How GEMFOS 35MG TABLET Works

GEMFOS 35MG TABLET works by slowing bone loss to help maintain strong bones and reduce the risk of broken bones (fractures).
usageDetails:
How to use GEMFOS 35MG TABLET

Always take GEMFOS 35MG TABLET before food in an upright position (you may sit or stand) to avoid heartburn or as advised by your doctor. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not lie down for 30 minutes after taking your tablet. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking GEMFOS 35MG TABLET without consulting your doctor, as you may begin to lose bone mass.

introduction:
Introduction About SHELCAL K TABLET

SHELCAL K TABLET is a combination of Calcitriol, Calcium Carbonate, and Menaquinone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Nutritional Supplements. It is used to manage osteoporosis.

Osteoporosis is a condition that causes the thinning and weakening of bones because of the excessive absorption of calcium from the bones. It is characterized by symptoms such as bleeding gums, weak grip strength, brittle fingernails, loss of height, frequent fractures, and neck and back pain.

SHELCAL K TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to calcitriol or calcium. It is also not recommended for use if you have kidney stones, hypercalcaemia (high blood calcium levels), or evidence of vitamin D toxicity.

SHELCAL K TABLET should be used with caution in cases of hepatic insufficiency, nephrotic diseases (a kidney disease causing excess protein in your urine), chronic renal failure, and a high tendency to get kidney stones. SHELCAL K TABLET should also be used with caution in patients undergoing dialysis.

SHELCAL K TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant women only if necessary. SHELCAL K TABLET is not recommended to be used by breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The common side effects associated with the use of SHELCAL K TABLET are diarrhea, constipation, an upset stomach, and abdominal pain. Contact your doctor or a nearby hospital if any of the conditions worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SHELCAL K TABLET Works

SHELCAL K TABLET helps in managing bone weakening, where calcitriol plays a very important role in aiding the absorption of calcium by acting on certain gut cells to increase the production of calcium transport proteins, whereas calcium carbonate acts by directly increasing the calcium stores in the body.

Vitamin K activates the calcium-binding actions of two proteins (the matrix GLA protein and osteocalcin), which helps in enhancing calcium absorption in the body, thereby increasing bone mass and strength.

introduction:
Introduction About IDROFOS 150MG TABLET

IDROFOS 150MG TABLET contains Ibandronic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lowers the chances of bone fracture, and used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition. IDROFOS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking IDROFOS 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems. IDROFOS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. IDROFOS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking IDROFOS 150MG TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.

Used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How IDROFOS 150MG TABLET Works

IDROFOS 150MG TABLET lowers osteoclast activity, which can help to reduce pain and strengthen the bone. It also reduces the amount of calcium that is lost from the bones and aids in the normalization of blood calcium levels.

introduction:
Introduction About ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE contains Alfacalcidol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogues. It is used to manage osteodystrophy (changes in bone caused by kidney failure) and changes in parathyroid glands (responsible for producing parathyroid hormone, which controls the amount of calcium in the body).

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE is also used to manage hypocalcaemia (decreased calcium levels) in newborn babies and osteomalacia or rickets (softening and deformity of the bones due to a lack of calcium).

During the management with ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE, your doctor may conduct blood tests to determine the amount of calcium and phosphorus in the blood, an enzyme called alkaline phosphatase, or the parathyroid hormone. You may also have other tests, such as X-rays, to determine the dose that fits you.

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with hypercalcaemia (high levels of calcium in the blood) or calcification (high levels of calcium in your body tissues). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, kidney stones, granulomas, or sarcoidosis (collection of inflammatory cells). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking. ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE can be used in children and elderly patients. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult with your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE are abdominal pain, rash, and itching. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE Works

ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE works by increasing the amount of vitamin D (controls the levels of calcium and phosphorus required for healthy bones and teeth) in the body. ALPHADOL 0.5MCG CAPSULE stimulates calcium absorption in the intestines, increases urinary calcium excretion and serum calcium levels, and suppresses parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion. Thus, increasing the levels of calcium and phosphate in the body and restoring the essential functions and activities of vitamin D.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE

CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE contains Calcitriol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is used to manage bone disorders caused by calcium deficiencies due to various disease conditions such as renal osteodystrophy, menopausal osteoporosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypocalcaemia, and hypophosphatemia. Your doctor will monitor your calcium and renal function levels to ensure the efficacy of CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE.

Renal osteodystrophy is a complication of chronic kidney disease that weakens bones. It is caused by changes in the levels of minerals and hormones in the blood. The main signs are bone pain and fractures. Menopausal osteoporosis is a condition where the bones start weakening in menopausal women.

Hyperparathyroidism is a condition when parathyroid hormones secrete excess thyroid hormones. Hypocalcemia refers to low levels of calcium in the blood. Hypophosphatemia indicates low levels of phosphorus in the blood.

CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with high levels of calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia), deposits of calcium (metastatic calcification), or high levels of vitamin D.

CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having difficulties moving due to medical conditions, surgeries, or kidney disease. Avoid consuming foods rich in vitamin D.

CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effect of CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE is high levels of calcium in the blood. Consult your doctor if any side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE Works

CALCIT SG 0.25MG CAPSULE acts on cells in the gastrointestinal tract to increase the production of calcium transport proteins (calbindin-D proteins), which results in increased uptake of calcium from the gut into the body. Calcitriol inhibits parathyroid hormone activity by decreasing parathyroid hormone synthesis and release. It promotes the absorption of dietary calcium from the gastrointestinal tract, increases renal tubular reabsorption of calcium, thus reducing the loss of calcium in the urine, and stimulates the release of calcium from bone. For this, it acts on the specific type of bone cells referred to as osteoblasts. This helps to form healthy bones and reduce bone damage.

introduction:
Introduction About ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE

ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE contains Alfacalcidol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogues. It is used to manage osteodystrophy (changes in bone caused by kidney failure) and changes in parathyroid glands (responsible for producing parathyroid hormone, which controls the amount of calcium in the body).

ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE is also used to manage hypocalcaemia (decreased calcium levels) in newborn babies and osteomalacia or rickets (softening and deformity of the bones due to a lack of calcium).

During the management with ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE, your doctor may conduct blood tests to determine the amount of calcium and phosphorus in the blood, an enzyme called alkaline phosphatase, or the parathyroid hormone. You may also have other tests, such as X-rays, to determine the dose that fits you.

ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with hypercalcaemia (high levels of calcium in the blood) or calcification (high levels of calcium in your body tissues). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, kidney stones, granulomas, or sarcoidosis (collection of inflammatory cells). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking. ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE can be used in children and elderly patients. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult with your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ALPHADOL 0.25MCG CAPSULE are abdominal pain, rash, and itching. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About ROCALTROL 0.25MCG CAPSULE

Rocaltrol 0.25 mcg Capsule contains calcitriol, the active form of Vitamin D3, which plays a key role in maintaining calcium and phosphate balance in the body. It is widely prescribed in conditions where calcium levels are disturbed, such as osteoporosis, hypoparathyroidism, renal osteodystrophy, and menopausal osteoporosis. By improving calcium absorption from the gut and reducing calcium loss through urine, Rocaltrol supports bone strength, healthy muscle function, and overall mineral balance. 

This medicine is ideally suited for patients with low calcium levels due to parathyroid disorders, chronic kidney problems, or bone diseases that require vitamin D supplementation. It is also helpful for postmenopausal women at higher risk of bone weakening. The capsule can be taken with or without food, usually once or twice daily, exactly as prescribed by the doctor. Regular blood tests may be recommended to monitor calcium, phosphate, and kidney function during therapy.

Patients should follow all precautions and dietary advice while using Rocaltrol. Excess intake of calcium-rich food, vitamin D supplements, or phosphate-heavy diets may lead to high calcium levels. It should be used cautiously in people with kidney stones, heart problems, or existing high calcium levels. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should use this medicine only under medical supervision, as dose adjustments may be necessary to avoid complications.

Common side effects include nausea, headache, constipation, stomach pain, and fatigue. In rare cases, high calcium levels may cause more serious symptoms like excessive thirst, frequent urination, or irregular heartbeat. Patients are advised not to change the dose on their own and to immediately consult a doctor if they notice unusual symptoms. With proper monitoring and guidance, Rocaltrol 0.25 mcg Capsule helps maintain strong bones and a healthier mineral balance in the body.

How ROCALTROL 0.25MCG CAPSULE Works
Rocaltrol Mechanism of Action

Rocaltrol 0.25 mcg Capsule contains calcitriol, which is the active form of Vitamin D3. It works by helping the body maintain the right balance of calcium and phosphate. Calcitriol acts on the intestines, kidneys, and bones to regulate calcium absorption and utilization.

In the intestines, it increases calcium and phosphate absorption from food.
In the bones, it helps release calcium when the body needs more.
In the kidneys, it reduces calcium loss through urine.

By controlling these processes, Rocaltrol supports healthy bones, proper muscle function, and stable calcium levels in the blood.

It can be taken with or without food but try to take it at the same time every day for best results.

introduction:
Introduction About BON K2 HD TABLET

Bon K2 HD Tablet is a bone health supplement helps to manage bone and joint health. It is also used in bone conditions like osteoporosis. It contains Calcium Citrate Malate, Vitamin D3 and Vitamin K2-7 as active ingredients.

Calcium citrate malate helps to maintain bone mass and slows the rate of bone loss. It provides calcium which plays a very important role in the body. It is necessary for normal functioning of nerves, cells, muscle and bone. Vitamin D helps the body to absorb calcium from the intestine and keeps your bones stronger. Vitamin k2-7 protects against bone loss and fractures.

Always take BON K2 HD Tablet as advised by your physician. Swallow the tablet with water. Do not crush or chew the tablet. Take one tablet daily or as directed by the doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take BON K2 HD Tablet if you are allergic to any of its components.

name: Osteofos 35mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET

OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET is used to manage osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones) in postmenopausal women. It helps to improve bone mass density in patients with weak bones and can also be used to manage osteoporosis caused by excessive use of corticosteroids (such as prednisone). It also helps in the management of Paget’s disease (abnormal bone growth due to disturbances in the normal span of bone cells). 

OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET contains Alendronic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It inhibits bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. It works by attaching itself to the bone surface and then stopping the action of certain bone cells that destroy the bone mass. It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and stops abnormal bone growth.

Take OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not lie down immediately after taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET. It is necessary to maintain good oral hygiene while undergoing management with OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET. Therefore, routinely have dental check-ups during management to avoid unwanted oral problems.

You should also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any oral problems such as tooth pain, swelling, or loosening after taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET.

Before taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in the kidneys or in the stomach or are scheduled for any oral management or dental surgery. Do not take OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use by patients having problems with their food pipe. It is also not suitable for use by patients who are unable to sit or stand upright for at least 30 minutes at a time.

The most common side effects of OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, bloating, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, or acid reflux. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects trouble you.

It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and stops abnormal bone growth. As a result, it improves bone mass, makes them stronger, and manages the risk of fracture.

How to use OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET

Take OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass full of plain water. Take OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET on an empty stomach or for at least 30 minutes before taking any food, drink, or medicine.

Do not consume tea, coffee, mineral water, or juice along with OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET. Do not lie down immediately after taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET. Avoid taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET at bedtime.

Stay upright (sitting, standing, or walking) for at least 30 minutes after taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET, and do not lie down until you have eaten the first meal of the day. This is followed to manage the reflux of medicine back to the oesophagus.

Your doctor will decide the appropriate dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET to improve your disease condition.

Do not stop taking OSTEOFOS 35MG TABLET without consulting your doctor, as it can reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Introduction About IBANDEOS 150 TABLET

IBANDEOS 150 TABLET contains Ibandronic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lowers the chances of bone fracture, and used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis. Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition. IBANDEOS 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking IBANDEOS 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems. IBANDEOS 150 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. IBANDEOS 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking IBANDEOS 150 TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.

name: BIO D3 Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE

BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE contains Calcitriol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is used to manage bone disorders caused by calcium deficiencies due to various disease conditions such as renal osteodystrophy, menopausal osteoporosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypocalcaemia, and hypophosphatemia. Your doctor will monitor your calcium and renal function levels to ensure the efficacy of BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE.

Renal osteodystrophy is a complication of chronic kidney disease that weakens bones. It is caused by changes in the levels of minerals and hormones in the blood. The main signs are bone pain and fractures. Menopausal osteoporosis is a condition where the bones start weakening in menopausal women.

Hyperparathyroidism is a condition when parathyroid hormones secrete excess thyroid hormones. Hypocalcemia refers to low levels of calcium in the blood. Hypophosphatemia indicates low levels of phosphorus in the blood.

BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with high levels of calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia), deposits of calcium (metastatic calcification), or high levels of vitamin D.

BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having difficulties moving due to medical conditions, surgeries, or kidney disease. Avoid consuming foods rich in vitamin D.

BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effect of BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE is high levels of calcium in the blood. Consult your doctor if any side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Renal osteodystrophy
Menopausal osteoporosis
Hyperparathyroidism
Hypocalcaemia
Hypophosphatemia
mechanismOfAction:
How BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE Works

BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE acts on cells in the gastrointestinal tract to increase the production of calcium transport proteins (calbindin-D proteins), which results in increased uptake of calcium from the gut into the body. Calcitriol inhibits parathyroid hormone activity by decreasing parathyroid hormone synthesis and release. It promotes the absorption of dietary calcium from the gastrointestinal tract, increases renal tubular reabsorption of calcium, thus reducing the loss of calcium in the urine, and stimulates the release of calcium from bone. For this, it acts on the specific type of bone cells referred to as osteoblasts. This helps to form healthy bones and reduce bone damage.
usageDetails:

Take BIO D3 0.25MCG CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the whole medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RISOFOS 35MG TABLET

RISOFOS 35MG TABLET contains Risedronate, which belongs to a group of medicines called Bisphosphonates, which are used to manage bone diseases. It is used to manage osteoporosis in postmenopausal women, increase bone mass in men with osteoporosis, and manage osteoporosis in men and women that is caused by management with steroid medicine such as prednisone. It is also used to manage Paget’s disease of the bone in men and women.

Osteoporosis is a bone disease that develops when bone mineral density and bone mass decrease or when the quality or structure of bone changes. This can lead to a decrease in bone strength, which can increase the risk of fracture (broken bone).

During postmenopausal osteoporosis, the bones become weaker, more fragile, and more likely to break after a fall or strain. Paget’s disease is a chronic bone disorder that results in enlarged, deformed bones due to excessive breakdown and formation of bone tissue that can cause bones to weaken and may result in bone pain, arthritis, deformities, or fracture.

Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you have ever had heart disease or liver problems. RISOFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe kidney diseases and low blood calcium levels. Consult your doctor for advice.

RISOFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

RISOFOS 35MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RISOFOS 35MG TABLET are indigestion, nausea, stomach pain or discomfort, constipation, feelings of fullness, bloating, diarrhea, pain in your bones, muscles, or joints, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RISOFOS 35MG TABLET Works

RISOFOS 35MG TABLET works by slowing bone loss to help maintain strong bones and reduce the risk of broken bones (fractures).
usageDetails:
How to use RISOFOS 35MG TABLET

Always take RISOFOS 35MG TABLET before food in an upright position (you may sit or stand) to avoid heartburn or as advised by your doctor. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not lie down for 30 minutes after taking your tablet. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking RISOFOS 35MG TABLET without consulting your doctor, as you may begin to lose bone mass.

name: Laretol Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About LARETOL INJECTION

LARETOL INJECTION contains Calcitriol, which belongs to the class of medications called vitamin D analogs. Calcitriol is indicated in the management of hypocalcemia in patients undergoing chronic renal dialysis. It significantly reduces elevated parathyroid hormone levels and shows improvement in renal osteodystrophy.

LARETOL INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have hypercalcemia (increased levels of calcium levels in the blood) or vitamin D toxicity (high vitamin D levels). Consult your doctor before taking it.

LARETOL INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless the potential benefit to the mother justifies the potential risk to the fetus. Consult your doctor for advice. Before using LARETOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are breastfeeding, as it is known whether it may pass through the breast milk.

The safety and efficacy of LARETOL INJECTION are not established in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. LARETOL INJECTION should be used with caution with elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of receiving LARETOL INJECTION are hypercalcemia (high calcium levels in the blood). Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after receiving LARETOL INJECTION.
uses: To manage hypocalcemia in patients undergoing chronic renal dialysis
usesDetails:

To manage hypocalcemia in patients undergoing chronic renal dialysis
Reduces elevated parathyroid hormone levels
mechanismOfAction:
How LARETOL INJECTION Works

LARETOL INJECTION elevates the plasma levels of calcium by stimulating intestinal calcium uptake, increasing reabsorption of calcium by the kidneys, and possibly increasing the release of calcium from skeletal stores. It works by helping the body use more of the calcium found in foods or supplements and regulating the body's production of parathyroid hormone.
usageDetails:
How to use LARETOL INJECTION

LARETOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LARETOL INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KINDTROL CAPSULE

KINDTROL CAPSULE contains Calcitriol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is used to manage bone disorders caused by calcium deficiencies due to various disease conditions such as renal osteodystrophy, menopausal osteoporosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypocalcaemia, and hypophosphatemia. Your doctor will monitor your calcium and renal function levels to ensure the efficacy of KINDTROL CAPSULE.

Renal osteodystrophy is a complication of chronic kidney disease that weakens bones. It is caused by changes in the levels of minerals and hormones in the blood. The main signs are bone pain and fractures. Menopausal osteoporosis is a condition where the bones start weakening in menopausal women.

Hyperparathyroidism is a condition when parathyroid hormones secrete excess thyroid hormones. Hypocalcemia refers to low levels of calcium in the blood. Hypophosphatemia indicates low levels of phosphorus in the blood.

KINDTROL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with high levels of calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia), deposits of calcium (metastatic calcification), or high levels of vitamin D.

KINDTROL CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having difficulties moving due to medical conditions, surgeries, or kidney disease. Avoid consuming foods rich in vitamin D.

KINDTROL CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. KINDTROL CAPSULE should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effect of KINDTROL CAPSULE is high levels of calcium in the blood. Consult your doctor if any side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KINDTROL CAPSULE

Renal osteodystrophy
Menopausal osteoporosis
Hyperparathyroidism
Hypocalcaemia
Hypophosphatemia
mechanismOfAction:
How KINDTROL CAPSULE Works

KINDTROL CAPSULE acts on cells in the gastrointestinal tract to increase the production of calcium transport proteins (calbindin-D proteins), which results in increased uptake of calcium from the gut into the body. Calcitriol inhibits parathyroid hormone activity by decreasing parathyroid hormone synthesis and release. It promotes the absorption of dietary calcium from the gastrointestinal tract, increases renal tubular reabsorption of calcium, thus reducing the loss of calcium in the urine, and stimulates the release of calcium from bone. For this, it acts on the specific type of bone cells referred to as osteoblasts. This helps to form healthy bones and reduce bone damage.

How to use KINDTROL CAPSULE

Take KINDTROL CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the whole medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Medicines used to manage infection and inflammation (Ex. hydrocortisone, prednisolone, and dexamethasone)

Avoid consuming foods rich in vitamin D, like milk and cheese, as they may increase calcium levels in the blood.

introduction:
Introduction About TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET

TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET Works

TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Take TREXODAT 7.5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION

ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION contains Zoledronic Acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to manage bone complications such as fractures and bone metastases (cancer that has spread from the original (primary) tumour to the bone) in adult patients and helps to reduce the amount of calcium in the blood in adult patients (tumour-induced hypercalcaemia (TIH)).

Along with management with ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION, your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes, such as eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D. Prior to starting management with ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before receiving ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have had or have pain, swelling or numbness of the jaw, a feeling of heaviness in the jaw or loosening of teeth, kidney disease, are having dental management, or are due to undergo dental surgery.

ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving ZOLDONAT 4MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, and anemia (a low number of red blood cells). Inform your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CARTIPIL TABLET

CARTIPIL TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane which belongs to the group of medicines called proteoglycan synthesis stimulators and nutritional supplements, respectively. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis is a condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

CARTIPIL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking CARTIPIL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have suffered from impaired glucose tolerance, kidney problems, heart disease, or asthma. CARTIPIL TABLET is generally not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

CARTIPIL TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). CARTIPIL TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CARTIPIL TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Ask your doctor for advice if any of these side effects worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARTIPIL TABLET Works

CARTIPIL TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane. Diacerein and glucosamine are proteoglycan synthesis stimulators that facilitate the formation of cartilage, which is an important structural component of the body. Methyl Sulfonyl Methane is a nutritional supplement that functions by lessening pain and swelling by reducing inflammation.

name: Auxitrol Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AUXITROL CAPSULE

Auxitrol Capsule is used as a dietary supplement in bone conditions like renal osteodystrophy and also improve bone health in patients with kidney problems. It is also used to improve weak bones in post-menopausal women called post-menopausal osteoporosis. It contains Calcitriol as an active ingredient which makes the body to absorb more calcium from the diet.

Calcitriol is a Vitamin D metabolite which works by making the body to absorb more calcium from the diet. This helps to form healthy bones and reduce any bone damage.

Take Auxitrol Capsule as directed by the doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water, do not crush or chew. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Your doctor may recommend regular blood tests to determine the level of calcium in the blood. It is not recommended for use in patients having high levels of calcium or vitamin D or extra have calcium deposits in the body. Consult your doctor if you experience any allergic reactions while taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE

OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE is a combination of Calcitriol, Calcium Carbonate, and Soya Isoflavones, which belong to a group of medicines known as Vitamin D analogues, Calcium supplements, and Phytoestrogens, respectively. OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE is indicated for the dietary management of the metabolic processes of bone defects like osteopenia and osteoporosis.

Osteopenia is a loss of bone mineral density (BMD) that weakens bones. Osteoporosis is a bone disease that develops when bone mineral density and bone mass decrease, or when the structure and strength of bones change. This can lead to a decrease in bone strength, which can increase the risk of fractures (broken bones).

OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with kidney stones, and it should be used with caution in patients with signs of impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice.

 OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy, if you think you may be pregnant, and in breastfeeding women. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor.

The common side effects of taking OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE are headache, stomach pain, nausea, rash, and signs of urinary tract infection (bladder pain, foul smell, cloudy urine, frequent urination). Consult your doctor if the symptoms do not improve.

How OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE Works

OSTEOFIT XT CAPSULE effectively improves bone strength. Calcitriol increases calcium levels by acting on the cells of the gastrointestinal tract to increase the uptake of calcium. Calcium carbonate is a nutritional supplement that directly increases the calcium stores in the body. Soya isoflavones stimulate the multiplication of bone-forming cells called osteoblasts, thereby increasing bone density.

introduction:
Introduction About NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION

NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION contains Zoledronic Acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to manage bone complications such as fractures and bone metastases (cancer that has spread from the original (primary) tumour to the bone) in adult patients and helps to reduce the amount of calcium in the blood in adult patients (tumour-induced hypercalcaemia (TIH)).

Along with management with NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION, your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes, such as eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D. Prior to starting management with NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before receiving NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have had or have pain, swelling or numbness of the jaw, a feeling of heaviness in the jaw or loosening of teeth, kidney disease, are having dental management, or are due to undergo dental surgery.

NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION.

The most common side effects of receiving NATZOLD 5MG INFUSION are headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, and anemia (a low number of red blood cells). Inform your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BONICAL C TABLET

Bonical C Tablet is a dietary supplement used to manage calcium deficiencies. It is also used in conditions like post-menopausal and corticosteroid induced osteoporosis. It contains Calcium carbonate and Calcitriol as active ingredients which is used to manage calcium deficiencies and promotes bone health.

Calcium carbonate is important for bone formation and maintenance. Calcitriol is the active form of vitamin D3 and it is important for the absorption of calcium from the stomach and for the functioning of calcium in the body.

Always take Bonical C Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE contains Alfacalcidol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogues. It is used to manage osteodystrophy (changes in bone caused by kidney failure) and changes in parathyroid glands (responsible for producing parathyroid hormone, which controls the amount of calcium in the body).

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE is also used to manage hypocalcaemia (decreased calcium levels) in newborn babies and osteomalacia or rickets (softening and deformity of the bones due to a lack of calcium).

During the management with ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE, your doctor may conduct blood tests to determine the amount of calcium and phosphorus in the blood, an enzyme called alkaline phosphatase, or the parathyroid hormone. You may also have other tests, such as X-rays, to determine the dose that fits you.

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with hypercalcaemia (high levels of calcium in the blood) or calcification (high levels of calcium in your body tissues). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, kidney stones, granulomas, or sarcoidosis (collection of inflammatory cells). Contact your doctor before taking.

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking. ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE can be used in children and elderly patients. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult with your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE are abdominal pain, rash, and itching. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE Works

ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE works by increasing the amount of vitamin D (controls the levels of calcium and phosphorus required for healthy bones and teeth) in the body. ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE stimulates calcium absorption in the intestines, increases urinary calcium excretion and serum calcium levels, and suppresses parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion. Thus, increasing the levels of calcium and phosphate in the body and restoring the essential functions and activities of vitamin D.

Take ALPHADOL 1MCG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water, and do not crush or chew the medicine. Dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ROKFOS INFUSION

ROKFOS INFUSION contains Zoledronic Acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to manage bone complications such as fractures and bone metastases (cancer that has spread from the original (primary) tumour to the bone) in adult patients and helps to reduce the amount of calcium in the blood in adult patients (tumour-induced hypercalcaemia (TIH)).

Along with management with ROKFOS INFUSION, your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes, such as eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D. Prior to starting management with ROKFOS INFUSION, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before receiving ROKFOS INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have had or have pain, swelling or numbness of the jaw, a feeling of heaviness in the jaw or loosening of teeth, kidney disease, are having dental management, or are due to undergo dental surgery.

ROKFOS INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ROKFOS INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving ROKFOS INFUSION.

The most common side effects of receiving ROKFOS INFUSION are headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, and anemia (a low number of red blood cells). Inform your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLEPHOS INFUSION

ZOLEPHOS INFUSION contains Zoledronic Acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to manage bone complications such as fractures and bone metastases (cancer that has spread from the original (primary) tumour to the bone) in adult patients and helps to reduce the amount of calcium in the blood in adult patients (tumour-induced hypercalcaemia (TIH)).

Along with management with ZOLEPHOS INFUSION, your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes, such as eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D. Prior to starting management with ZOLEPHOS INFUSION, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before receiving ZOLEPHOS INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have had or have pain, swelling or numbness of the jaw, a feeling of heaviness in the jaw or loosening of teeth, kidney disease, are having dental management, or are due to undergo dental surgery.

ZOLEPHOS INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ZOLEPHOS INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving ZOLEPHOS INFUSION.

The most common side effects of receiving ZOLEPHOS INFUSION are headache, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, and anemia (a low number of red blood cells). Inform your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

ZOLEPHOS INFUSION works by suppressing the activity of osteoclasts, cells that cause the destruction of bones. This strengthens the bones and minimizes the risk of fractures.

name: Caltive Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALTIVE CAPSULE

CALTIVE CAPSULE contains Calcitriol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is used to manage bone disorders caused by calcium deficiencies due to various disease conditions such as renal osteodystrophy, menopausal osteoporosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypocalcaemia, and hypophosphatemia. Your doctor will monitor your calcium and renal function levels to ensure the efficacy of CALTIVE CAPSULE.

Renal osteodystrophy is a complication of chronic kidney disease that weakens bones. It is caused by changes in the levels of minerals and hormones in the blood. The main signs are bone pain and fractures. Menopausal osteoporosis is a condition where the bones start weakening in menopausal women.

Hyperparathyroidism is a condition when parathyroid hormones secrete excess thyroid hormones. Hypocalcemia refers to low levels of calcium in the blood. Hypophosphatemia indicates low levels of phosphorus in the blood.

CALTIVE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with high levels of calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia), deposits of calcium (metastatic calcification), or high levels of vitamin D.

CALTIVE CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having difficulties moving due to medical conditions, surgeries, or kidney disease. Avoid consuming foods rich in vitamin D.

CALTIVE CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. CALTIVE CAPSULE should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effect of CALTIVE CAPSULE is high levels of calcium in the blood. Consult your doctor if any side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALTIVE CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Renal osteodystrophy
Menopausal osteoporosis
Hyperparathyroidism
Hypocalcaemia
Hypophosphatemia
mechanismOfAction:
How CALTIVE CAPSULE Works

CALTIVE CAPSULE acts on cells in the gastrointestinal tract to increase the production of calcium transport proteins (calbindin-D proteins), which results in increased uptake of calcium from the gut into the body. Calcitriol inhibits parathyroid hormone activity by decreasing parathyroid hormone synthesis and release. It promotes the absorption of dietary calcium from the gastrointestinal tract, increases renal tubular reabsorption of calcium, thus reducing the loss of calcium in the urine, and stimulates the release of calcium from bone. For this, it acts on the specific type of bone cells referred to as osteoblasts. This helps to form healthy bones and reduce bone damage.
usageDetails:
How to use CALTIVE CAPSULE

Take CALTIVE CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the whole medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.
