introduction:
Introduction About BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION

BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION contains Ibandronic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used in adults with breast cancer that has spread to bones to manage bone fractures and other bone problems that may need surgery or radiotherapy. Breast cancer is a cancer that forms in the cells of the breasts. Symptoms include lumps in the breast and changes in size, shape, and skin over the breast.

BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who have or have had low blood calcium levels. Before receiving BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health or gum disease), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, high or low levels of vitamin D, calcium, or other minerals, and have kidney disease or heart problems.

Prior to the management, your doctor may ask you to undergo a dental examination and advise you to maintain good oral hygiene, such as regular teeth brushing, and receive routine dental check-ups.

BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age.

The most common side effects of receiving BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION are flu-like symptoms, stomach pain, headache, bruising, tooth, and skin problems. Inform your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Breast cancer that has spread to bones
Bone problems that may need surgery
usesDetails:
Uses Of BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION

It is used by adults to manage:

Breast cancer that has spread to bones
Bone fracture
Bone problems that may need surgery
mechanismOfAction:
How BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION Works

BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION works by reducing the amount of calcium that is lost from bones, inhibiting osteoclast activity, and reducing bone resorption and turnover, with a net gain in bone mass. Thus, it helps to stop your bones from getting weaker.
usageDetails:
How to use BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION

BANDRONE 6MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Bandrone 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BANDRONE 50MG TABLET

BANDRONE 50MG TABLET contains Ibandronic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Bisphosphonates. It is used to reverse bone loss and increase bone mass in women, lower the chances of bone fracture, and manage postmenopausal osteoporosis.

Osteoporosis is the thinning and weakening of the bones, which is common in women after menopause. Symptoms include back pain, loss of height over time, stooped posture and easy bone fractures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to maintain a healthy lifestyle, like eating a balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, walking or any other weight-bearing exercise, maintaining good oral hygiene, and avoiding smoking and alcohol consumption. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take X-rays to understand your existing condition.

BANDRONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having certain problems with the gullet or food pipe (esophagus), such as narrowing or difficulty swallowing, being unable to stand or sit upright for at least one hour at a time and having low blood calcium levels.

Before taking BANDRONE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or have ever had problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, or tooth extraction), have not had a dental checkup for a long time, are a smoker, have cancer, disturbances of mineral metabolism (vitamin D deficiency), kidney disease, swallowing, or digestive problems.

BANDRONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. BANDRONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking BANDRONE 50MG TABLET are headache, heartburn, discomfort in swallowing, nausea, indigestion, and stomach pain.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BANDRONE 50MG TABLET
To manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How BANDRONE 50MG TABLET Works

BANDRONE 50MG TABLET lowers osteoclast activity, which can help to reduce pain and strengthen the bone. It also reduces the amount of calcium that is lost from the bones and aids in the normalization of blood calcium levels.
usageDetails:
How to use BANDRONE 50MG TABLET

Take BANDRONE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. For the next one hour after taking the medicine, do not lie down, eat, or drink anything. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Calorich M Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALORICH M TABLET

Calorich M Tablet is a dietary supplement specially formulated to maintain healthy bones. It promotes bone health, reduces the risk of maternal osteoporosis and supports neuro muscular health. It also maintains a healthy immune system. It contains Calcitriol, Calcium Citrate, Magnesium Hydroxide, Menaquinone, Methylcobalamin and Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate as active ingredients.

Calcitriol regulates calcium levels by increasing the absorption of calcium and phosphate, maintains strength of bones, teeth and a healthy immune system. Calcium citrate used in bone and joint weakening with weight regulation effects, assists in maintaining cell connective tissues in the body. It is also essential for normal bone formation and is involved in the biochemical activities of Vitamin D. Zinc sulphate has significant role in collagen synthesis and cell proliferation during wound healing process. Magnesium hydroxide helps in the balancing of stomach acid so that the proper absorption of this medication becomes possible. Menaquinone is an essential vitamin needed by the body used for blood clotting, bone building, and other important processes. Methylcobalamin is the active form of vitamin B12 useful for the brain and nerves, and to produce red blood cells.

Take Calorich M Tablet as advised by the physician. Do not crush or chew. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

name: TREXODAT 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TREXODAT 10 TABLET

TREXODAT 10 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. TREXODAT 10 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

TREXODAT 10 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

TREXODAT 10 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, TREXODAT 10 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

TREXODAT 10 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, TREXODAT 10 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How TREXODAT 10 TABLET Works

TREXODAT 10 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

TREXODAT 10 TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking TREXODAT 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)

Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)

Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)

name: MAXTONIN Nasal Spray 6ml
introduction:
Introduction About MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY

MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY contains Calcitonin which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium metabolism modifiers. It is used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones caused during menopause) in women who have crossed 5 years of menopause when other managements are not appropriate.

Prior to the management, the doctor will perform a skin test to determine whether you are allergic to calcitonin or not. During management with MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY, your doctor may take several bone-related tests to evaluate improvement in your condition. You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY to improve your disease condition.

Before using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have low blood calcium levels or any type of cancer as a precaution. Do not use MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY are nasal irritation, headache, back pain, and muscle pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY

It is used among women (greater than 5 years of menopause) to:

Manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY Works

MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY stops the action of certain bone cells (such as osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. This action manages bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. As a result, it makes your bones stronger and reduces the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY

Use MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Prior to use, prime the device by pressing 2-3 puffs in the air. Place the nozzle of the device inside your nostril and gently press the pump to release the spray.

As MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY must be stored in the refrigerator, allow it to come to room temperature before use.

Your doctor will decide the suitable dose, number of sprays, and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY without consulting your doctor.
sideEffects: Severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, eyes, tongue, or throat causing wheezing or difficulty breathing, chest tightness, a fall in blood pressure, or an increased heartbeat)
Signs of hypocalcemia (such as tingling or numbness of fingers, toes, or around the mouth)
Severe nasal irritation with nasal bleeding, redness, swelling or soreness, crusting sensation, and nasal dryness
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY
Common
Back pain, muscle pain
Headache
Runny nose
Nasal irritation or dryness
Rare

Stop using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects, such as:

Severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, eyes, tongue, or throat causing wheezing or difficulty breathing, chest tightness, a fall in blood pressure, or an increased heartbeat)
Signs of hypocalcemia (such as tingling or numbness of fingers, toes, or around the mouth)
Severe nasal irritation with nasal bleeding, redness, swelling or soreness, crusting sensation, and nasal dryness

warnings.details: There are no adequate studies to confirm the effects of MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY on pregnant women. Therefore, MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician.

There are no adequate studies to confirm whether MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY can pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your abilities are affected by MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY.
Talk to your doctor before using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to calcitonin.
MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

Before using MAXTONIN NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have:

Hypocalcaemia (low calcium levels in the blood)
Any form of cancer

name: NU PTH Injection 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About NU PTH INJECTION

NU PTH INJECTION is used in both men and postmenopausal women with Osteoporosis who are at high risk for having fractures. It contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anabolic agents. NU PTH INJECTION works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures. NU PTH INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. NU PTH INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of NU PTH INJECTION are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY

GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY contains Calcitonin which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium metabolism modifiers. It is used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones caused during menopause) in women who have crossed 5 years of menopause when other managements are not appropriate.

Prior to the management, the doctor will perform a skin test to determine whether you are allergic to calcitonin or not. During management with GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY, your doctor may take several bone-related tests to evaluate improvement in your condition. You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY to improve your disease condition.

Before using GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have low blood calcium levels or any type of cancer as a precaution. Do not use GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY are nasal irritation, headache, back pain, and muscle pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY

It is used among women (greater than 5 years of menopause) to:

Manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY Works

GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY stops the action of certain bone cells (such as osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. This action manages bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. As a result, it makes your bones stronger and reduces the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY

Use GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Prior to use, prime the device by pressing 2-3 puffs in the air. Place the nozzle of the device inside your nostril and gently press the pump to release the spray.

As GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY must be stored in the refrigerator, allow it to come to room temperature before use.

Your doctor will decide the suitable dose, number of sprays, and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop using GEMCAL NASAL SPRAY without consulting your doctor.

name: CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 Softgel Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE contains Alfacalcidol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogues. It is used to manage osteodystrophy (changes in bone caused by kidney failure) and changes in parathyroid glands (responsible for producing parathyroid hormone, which controls the amount of calcium in the body).

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is also used to manage hypocalcaemia (decreased calcium levels) in newborn babies and osteomalacia or rickets (softening and deformity of the bones due to a lack of calcium).

During the management with CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE, your doctor may conduct blood tests to determine the amount of calcium and phosphorus in the blood, an enzyme called alkaline phosphatase, or the parathyroid hormone. You may also have other tests, such as X-rays, to determine the dose that fits you.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with hypercalcaemia (high levels of calcium in the blood) or calcification (high levels of calcium in your body tissues). Contact your doctor before taking.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, kidney stones, granulomas, or sarcoidosis (collection of inflammatory cells). Contact your doctor before taking.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking. CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE can be used in children and elderly patients. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult with your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE are abdominal pain, rash, and itching. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE Works

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE works by increasing the amount of vitamin D (controls the levels of calcium and phosphorus required for healthy bones and teeth) in the body. CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE stimulates calcium absorption in the intestines, increases urinary calcium excretion and serum calcium levels, and suppresses parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion. Thus, increasing the levels of calcium and phosphate in the body and restoring the essential functions and activities of vitamin D.

Take CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.25 SOFTGEL CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water, and do not crush or chew the medicine. Dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Calspray Spray 3.7ml
introduction:
Introduction About CALSPRAY SPRAY

CALSPRAY SPRAY contains Calcitonin which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium metabolism modifiers. It is used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones caused during menopause) in women who have crossed 5 years of menopause when other managements are not appropriate.

Prior to the management, the doctor will perform a skin test to determine whether you are allergic to calcitonin or not. During management with CALSPRAY SPRAY, your doctor may take several bone-related tests to evaluate improvement in your condition. You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with CALSPRAY SPRAY to improve your disease condition.

Before using CALSPRAY SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have low blood calcium levels or any type of cancer as a precaution. Do not use CALSPRAY SPRAY without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using CALSPRAY SPRAY are nasal irritation, headache, back pain, and muscle pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALSPRAY SPRAY

It is used among women (greater than 5 years of menopause) to:

Manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CALSPRAY SPRAY Works

CALSPRAY SPRAY stops the action of certain bone cells (such as osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. This action manages bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. As a result, it makes your bones stronger and reduces the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use CALSPRAY SPRAY

Use CALSPRAY SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Prior to use, prime the device by pressing 2-3 puffs in the air. Place the nozzle of the device inside your nostril and gently press the pump to release the spray.

As CALSPRAY SPRAY must be stored in the refrigerator, allow it to come to room temperature before use.

Your doctor will decide the suitable dose, number of sprays, and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop using CALSPRAY SPRAY without consulting your doctor.

name: Bonmax Pth 750mcg Injection 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION

BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION is used in both men and postmenopausal women with Osteoporosis who are at high risk for having fractures. It contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anabolic agents. BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures. BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of BONMAX PTH 750MCG INJECTION are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE

TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE is used in the management of osteoporosis. It contains a medicine called teriparatide which is an anabolic agent that is used to make the bones stronger, and to reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:

Management of Osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE Works

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures.
usageInstructions: TERIFRAC 750MCG CARTRIDGE can be administered by a doctor or nurse or can also be self-administered
Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly.
Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy.
Follow your doctor's instructions carefully regarding the dosage and schedule.
Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration.
Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to prevent skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
Teriparatide should not be used for more than 2 years over a lifetime.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: CALCITOMIN Spray 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About CALCITOMIN SPRAY

CALCITOMIN SPRAY contains Calcitonin which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium metabolism modifiers. It is used to manage postmenopausal osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones caused during menopause) in women who have crossed 5 years of menopause when other managements are not appropriate.

Prior to the management, the doctor will perform a skin test to determine whether you are allergic to calcitonin or not. During management with CALCITOMIN SPRAY, your doctor may take several bone-related tests to evaluate improvement in your condition. You may also be prescribed vitamin D or calcium supplements along with CALCITOMIN SPRAY to improve your disease condition.

Before using CALCITOMIN SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have low blood calcium levels or any type of cancer as a precaution. Do not use CALCITOMIN SPRAY without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using CALCITOMIN SPRAY are nasal irritation, headache, back pain, and muscle pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALCITOMIN SPRAY

It is used among women (greater than 5 years of menopause) to:

Manage postmenopausal osteoporosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CALCITOMIN SPRAY Works

CALCITOMIN SPRAY stops the action of certain bone cells (such as osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. This action manages bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. As a result, it makes your bones stronger and reduces the risk of fracture.
usageDetails:
How to use CALCITOMIN SPRAY

Use CALCITOMIN SPRAY as advised by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Prior to use, prime the device by pressing 2-3 puffs in the air. Place the nozzle of the device inside your nostril and gently press the pump to release the spray.

As CALCITOMIN SPRAY must be stored in the refrigerator, allow it to come to room temperature before use.

Your doctor will decide the suitable dose, number of sprays, and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop using CALCITOMIN SPRAY without consulting your doctor.

name: Rockbon Pth 750mg Injection 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION

ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION is used in both men and postmenopausal women with Osteoporosis who are at high risk for having fractures. It contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anabolic agents. ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures. ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of ROCKBON PTH 750MG INJECTION are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About VISCOSAFE

VISCOSAFE contains Sodium Hyaluronate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic Viscoelastic Agents. It is used in the management of mild to severe dry eyes, post-operated dry eyes, and corneal burns.

Dry eye, which occurs when tears aren't able to provide adequate moisture, can affect one or both of the eyes. It occurs for various reasons, such as environmental conditions, aging, the use of contact lenses, and medications. Symptoms include dry, red, and inflamed, discomfort, and sensitivity to light.

Before using VISCOSAFE, inform your doctor if you have narrow-angle glaucoma and if you wear contact lenses.

VISCOSAFE may cause blurred vision for a short time after application, even at normal dosages and with proper use. This can subsequently impair your reaction while driving or operating machines; hence, caution should be exercised. 

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before using VISCOSAFE.

The most common side effects of using VISCOSAFE are blurred vision, swelling of the eyelids, eye redness, discomfort, and irritation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VISCOSAFE

Used for:

Mild-to-severe dry eyes
Post-operative dry eyes
Corneal burns
mechanismOfAction:
How VISCOSAFE Works

VISCOSAFE makes the lubricating contents of the eye more viscous, and hence the eye is provided with an intensive, soothing, and moisturizing film. Persistent or more severe symptoms of dry eye are relieved, and the eye is protected against further irritation.
usageDetails:
How to use VISCOSAFE

Use VISCOSAFE as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. To apply the medicine, tilt your head back and look up. Gently pull down the lower lid to form a sac, look up at the bottle, squeeze the bottle to place drops into the sac of your lower lid, and then blink to spread the eye drop across the surface of the eye. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of VISCOSAFE for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

name: SALMONCAL 100mg Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION

SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION contains Calcitonin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium metabolism modifiers. It is used to manage Paget’s disease (abnormal bone growth) and postmenopausal osteoporosis (weak or brittle bones caused during menopause) when other managements are not appropriate.

It can also be used to manage bone loss in patients who remain bed-ridden or immobile due to fractures and to reduce blood calcium levels in patients with hypercalcemia (high blood calcium levels) caused by cancer.

Prior to the management, the doctor will perform a skin test to determine whether you are allergic to calcitonin or not. Before receiving SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any type of cancer as a precaution.

SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with hypocalcemia (low blood calcium levels). It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women or in children aged below 18 years.

The most common side effects of receiving SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, tiredness, pain in bones and joints, redness of the face or neck, dizziness, headache, and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION Works

SALMONCAL 100MG INJECTION stops the action of certain bone cells (such as osteoclasts) that destroy the bone mass. This action manages bone loss and helps build bone mass and density. It also stabilizes the replacement of new bone tissue growth and manages abnormal bone growth. Additionally, it can reduce blood calcium levels by excreting calcium from the body in the form of urine.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE contains Alfacalcidol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogues. It is used to manage osteodystrophy (changes in bone caused by kidney failure) and changes in parathyroid glands (responsible for producing parathyroid hormone, which controls the amount of calcium in the body).

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is also used to manage hypocalcaemia (decreased calcium levels) in newborn babies and osteomalacia or rickets (softening and deformity of the bones due to a lack of calcium).

During the management with CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE, your doctor may conduct blood tests to determine the amount of calcium and phosphorus in the blood, an enzyme called alkaline phosphatase, or the parathyroid hormone. You may also have other tests, such as X-rays, to determine the dose that fits you.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with hypercalcaemia (high levels of calcium in the blood) or calcification (high levels of calcium in your body tissues). Contact your doctor before taking.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, kidney stones, granulomas, or sarcoidosis (collection of inflammatory cells). Contact your doctor before taking.

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking. CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE can be used in children and elderly patients. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult with your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE are abdominal pain, rash, and itching. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE Works

CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE works by increasing the amount of vitamin D (controls the levels of calcium and phosphorus required for healthy bones and teeth) in the body. CALCIGIANT ALPHA 0.5 SOFTGEL CAPSULE stimulates calcium absorption in the intestines, increases urinary calcium excretion and serum calcium levels, and suppresses parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion. Thus, increasing the levels of calcium and phosphate in the body and restoring the essential functions and activities of vitamin D.

introduction:
Introduction About TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION

TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION is used in both men and postmenopausal women with Osteoporosis who are at high risk for having fractures. It contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anabolic agents. TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures. TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of TRICIUM PTH 750MCG INJECTION are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

name: Prolia 60mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About PROLIA 60MG INJECTION

PROLIA 60MG INJECTION contains Denosumab which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoclonal antibodies. It is used in adults to manage advanced cancer and to manage serious complications caused by bone metastasis (Ex. fractures, pressure on the spinal cord, radiation therapy, or surgery). It is also used to manage giant cell tumours of the bone, which cannot be managed by surgery, especially in adults whose bones have stopped growing. Symptoms include a visible mass and bone joints being affected (fracture, fluid buildup, limited movement, swelling, and pain in the joints).

Denosumab binds to RANKL, a protein that is essential for the formation, function, and survival of osteoclasts (the cells responsible for bone resorption). It inhibits osteoclast formation, function, and survival, thereby decreasing bone resorption and increasing bone mass and strength. Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes, such as maintaining good oral hygiene and quitting smoking. Your doctor may ask you to undergo a dental examination before you start the management. PROLIA 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with hypocalcemia (low calcium levels in the blood) and unhealed wounds from oral surgery. Before receiving PROLIA 60MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, etc.).

PROLIA 60MG INJECTION is not recommended among women who are pregnant. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving PROLIA 60MG INJECTION if you are breast-feeding. PROLIA 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for children and adolescents under 18 years of age, except for adolescents with giant cell tumours of the bone whose bones have stopped growing. The most common side effects of receiving PROLIA 60MG INJECTION are pain in the bones, joints, and muscles, shortness of breath, diarrhea, hypophosphatemia (low phosphate level), and excessive sweating.

name: DENU Prefilled Syringe(Pfs) 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS)

DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) contains Denosumab which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoclonal antibodies. It is used in adults to manage advanced cancer and to manage serious complications caused by bone metastasis (Ex. fractures, pressure on the spinal cord, radiation therapy, or surgery). It is also used to manage giant cell tumours of the bone, which cannot be managed by surgery, especially in adults whose bones have stopped growing. Symptoms include a visible mass and bone joints being affected (fracture, fluid buildup, limited movement, swelling, and pain in the joints).

Denosumab binds to RANKL, a protein that is essential for the formation, function, and survival of osteoclasts (the cells responsible for bone resorption). It inhibits osteoclast formation, function, and survival, thereby decreasing bone resorption and increasing bone mass and strength. Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes, such as maintaining good oral hygiene and quitting smoking. Your doctor may ask you to undergo a dental examination before you start the management. DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is not recommended for use in patients with hypocalcemia (low calcium levels in the blood) and unhealed wounds from oral surgery. Before receiving DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS), inform your doctor if you have any problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, etc.).

DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is not recommended among women who are pregnant. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) if you are breast-feeding. DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) is not recommended for children and adolescents under 18 years of age, except for adolescents with giant cell tumours of the bone whose bones have stopped growing. The most common side effects of receiving DENU PREFILLED SYRINGE(PFS) are pain in the bones, joints, and muscles, shortness of breath, diarrhea, hypophosphatemia (low phosphate level), and excessive sweating.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE)

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Bone anabolic agents. GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) is used in adults to manage osteoporosis to make bones stronger and reduce the risk of bone fracture which generally occurs more commonly in women (after menopause) than in men.

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Teriparatide. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypercalcaemia (high calcium level in blood), certain bone diseases, Paget’s disease (condition that disrupts the replacement of old bone tissue with new bone tissue), and severe kidney problems.

Before receiving GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE), inform your doctor if you have liver disease (such as hepatic impairment), and/or kidney problems (such as moderate renal impairment, kidney stones).

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 80 years and above) after consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) are pain in limb, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting, heartburn, headache, and/or dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE)
Manage osteoporosis in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) Works

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) works by increasing the number and activity of osteoblasts (bone-forming cells) which leads to strengthening of bones and minimizes the risk of fractures thus managing osteoporosis in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE)

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into thigh/abdominal region as a subcutaneous injection. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE), inform your doctor if you are receiving any of the following medicine:

Digoxin (medicines used to manage heart failure)
Corticosteroids (used to reduce inflammation) Ex.  cortisone, hydrocortisone

Overdosage:

GEMTIDE PREFILLED 600MCG PEN(DEVICE) will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, contact your physician or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms such as  nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and/or headache.
